scope: Published-package consumer review after release-stabilization-036 stopped on @ai-matrx/content-ir freshness. The stop saw 0.19.13 versus npm 0.19.14; the guarded refresh installed 0.19.15 before review ended. No install, build, tests, or browser run in this lane.

actual_deltas.0.19.13_to_0.19.14: Published /source JS and declarations add normalizeLinkLabel, collectLinkDefinitions, resolveReferenceLinks, and LinkDefinition for reference links in split document fragments. Table opening now excludes lines inside an HTML block; BLOCK_START includes footnote definitions. The main and /source bundles change. The 0.19.14 changelog's metadata-only wording is inaccurate, though it states no consumer action.
actual_deltas.0.19.14_to_0.19.15: Published tarball member hashes show only CHANGELOG.md and package.json changed; dist/source.js and dist/source.d.ts are byte-identical. No additional source adoption.

extension_applicability.imports: Extension source imports @ai-matrx/content-ir/core and /wire for envelope, partial-kind, and inbound metadata handling. It has no @ai-matrx/content-ir/source import or calls to the new link helpers or table detectors.
extension_applicability.consumer_action: No required extension source migration. The /source behavior is real package behavior for any transitive consumer; root's release checks and browser verification remain necessary.

refresh_observed.lockfileDelta: Only content-ir 0.19.13 to 0.19.15 and the two transitive references to it; package.json already declares latest.

verdict: NO_REQUIRED_EXTENSION_SOURCE_ADOPTION. Runtime behavior and release retry are not verified by this lane.
